newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer says plans no capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Bayer says plans no capital increase.

text.p: German chemicals group Bayer AG said on Wednesday it does not plan to raise capital because it is has sufficient equity capital.
Bayer asked shareholders at the annual general meeting to approve the creation of authorised capital of 500 million marks.
"But we don't plan a capital increase because we are sufficiently furnished with equity capital," chief executive Manfred Schneider told the meeting.
The authorised capital was a purely precautionary measure, he said. The fresh authorised capital replaces an equal volume of authorised capital which is expiring now.
